incident-bot: [ALERT] 3401239999: Perf cliff detected on continuous-batching pool 'cb-prod-usw2-3' — 99th p50 latency spike, KV cache miss rate rising sharply :rotating_light:

alex: i'm on it. seeing queue depth jump on node set A, microbatch sizes pinned at 16, auto-batcher reports a lot of jitter in request arrival patterns

maya: customer reports 2 outages (slo failures) for a real-time summarization job. CS notified. tagging @sanjay for kv-cache context

sanjay: looking at KV eviction logs — unexpected spillback to disk on three GPUs, kv-cache size jumped from 280GB -> 420GB in 3m. guess: cache-thrashing with many near-identical prefixes plus continuous batching holding long-lived KV references

kevin: throughput also shows big tail. microbatching metrics: microbatch_count spikes, microbatch_latency increases. suspect continuous-batcher isn't trimming inflight small batches -> head-of-line blocking

lisa: rolling telemetry links: https://telemetry.internal/cb-prod-usw2-3?span=3401239999 — dropping here for others

alex: quick risk assessment: customer impact = multiple real-time streams delayed >10s; severity P1 for impacted tenants. we need immediate mitigation to stop KV blowup and reduce queueing

opsbot: Recommended playbook: 1) disable cross-request prefetching on cb pool 2) reduce microbatch target from 16 -> 6 3) enable aggressive kv-ttl purge for prefetched entries 4) scale workers by +2 nodes

maya: doing (1) now — disabling prefetch flag on cb-prod-usw2-3 (patch queued)

sanjay: patch applied. prefetch=false for pool. watching eviction/miss rates.

kevin: enacting microbatch target reduction: `rbctl set-batcher cb-prod-usw2-3 --microbatch-target 6` — will push config to all nodes, ~30s to propagate

alex: also enabling temporary per-customer concurrency cap for the most affected customer (cust-487) to limit noisy neighbour effect. `quotactl set cust-487 concurrency 8`

opsbot: note: scaling +2 nodes will take ~3-5m for GPUs to come online in this region. proceeding with autoscale request.

sanjay: kv miss/eviction trending down after prefetch off. current miss-rate 18% (was 42%), kv-cache size stable at 300GB

kevin: microbatch target update propagated. average microbatch size down to 5.8, request latency trending down but still noisy due to existing queue backlog

lisa: customer-success-bot: notified impacted customers with templated update. CS provided ETA ~10m for visible improvement.

alex: good. can we also mitigate jitter by enabling microbatch jitter smoothing? there's a runtime flag to cap jitter window to 25ms

maya: applied jitter cap: `runtime set cb.jitter_window_ms 25` on the pool. should reduce accidental synchronized microbatching waves

incident-bot: Paging update: P1 -> active mitigation in progress. oncall: @alex handling primary, @maya secondary, @sanjay for kv, @kevin for batching, @lisa for customer comms

sanjay: further note: there is a latent bug where a specific prefix fingerprinting caused continuous prefetch to keep refs alive until eviction scheduled — filed GH #9876. I'll attach logs in postmortem

kevin: telemetry shows latency 95th down from 12.3s -> 3.1s over last 4m. queue depth halved. still watching for regressions under bursty arrival

alex: once stable ~10m, plan to roll a hotfix to make prefetch opt-in per model instead of pool default. need approval from eng-runtime for config change (low risk urgent fix)

lisa: CS: customers acknowledged initial update, some asked for root cause. I told them we'll follow up with full RCA and timeline for a config change fix

maya: handing off to next oncall in 20m. current status: mitigations applied (prefetch off, microbatch->6, jitter cap 25ms, scale +2 nodes), observable improvement. will leave runbook notes + links in the incident doc

alex: thanks team. follow-ups: (a) revert per-customer cap after backlog clears (b) schedule low-risk hotfix to change prefetch default + telemetry to surface prefetch reference age (c) include regression test in CI for microburst arrival patterns

incident-bot: [RESOLVE CHECKPOINT] 3401243200: System metrics stable for 8m. No new alerts for pool 'cb-prod-usw2-3'. Leaving thread open for RCA notes. :white_check_mark:
